verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלֹא־ עָשָׂ֧ה הַיָּשָׁ֛ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּדָוִ֥יד אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh ’ā·ḥāz bə·mā·lə·ḵōw wə·šêš- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·lō- ‘ā·śāh hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḏā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: Ahaz was twenty years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen . . . years And unlike David his father he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Acaz tinha vinte anos quando começou a reinar e reinou dezesseis anos em Jerusalém. Não fez o que era reto aos olhos de Jeová, como Davi, seu pai,

verses.original: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּדַרְכֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְגַ֧ם מַסֵּכ֛וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה לַבְּעָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bə·ḏar·ḵê mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḡam mas·sê·ḵō·wṯ ‘ā·śāh lab·bə·‘ā·lîm
verses.literal: Instead, he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and even made cast images of the Baals
verses.literalPt: mas andou pelos caminhos dos reis de Israel e até fez imagens fundidas para os Baalins.

verses.original: וְה֥וּא הִקְטִ֖יר בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֑ם וַיַּבְעֵ֤ר אֶת־ בָּנָיו֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ כְּתֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū hiq·ṭîr bə·ḡê ḇen- hin·nōm way·yaḇ·‘êr ’eṯ- bā·nāw bā·’êš kə·ṯō·‘ă·ḇō·wṯ hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hō·rîš ha·šêm mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Moreover, Ahaz burned incense in the Valley of Ben-hinnom and sacrificed his sons in the fire according to the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Também queimou incenso no vale do Filho de Hinom, e queimou seus filhos no fogo, conforme as abominações das nações, a quem Jeová desapossou de diante dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְזַבֵּ֧חַ וַיְקַטֵּ֛ר בַּבָּמ֖וֹת וְעַל־ הַגְּבָע֑וֹת וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־ עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·zab·bê·aḥ way·qaṭ·ṭêr bab·bā·mō·wṯ wə·‘al- hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ kāl- ‘êṣ ra·‘ă·nān
verses.literal: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places on the hills and under every green tree
verses.literalPt: Sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altos, e nos outeiros, e debaixo de toda árvore frondosa.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֜הוּ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָיו֮ בְּיַ֣ד מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָם֒ וַיַּ֨כּוּ־ ב֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁבּ֤וּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ שִׁבְיָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַיָּבִ֖יאוּ דַּרְמָ֑שֶׂק וְ֠גַם בְּיַד־ מֶ֤לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נִתָּ֔ן וַיַּךְ־ בּ֖וֹ מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nê·hū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw bə·yaḏ me·leḵ ’ă·rām way·yak·kū- ḇōw way·yiš·bū mim·men·nū šiḇ·yāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh way·yā·ḇî·’ū dar·mā·śeq wə·ḡam bə·yaḏ- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl nit·tān way·yaḵ- bōw mak·kāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh
verses.literal: So the LORD his God delivered Ahaz into the hand of the king of Aram who attacked him and took . . . many . . . captives to Damascus Ahaz was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel who struck him with great force
verses.literalPt: Pelo que Jeová, seu Deus, o entregou nas mãos do rei da Síria. Feriram-no e tomaram-lhe uma grande multidão de cativos, que levaram para Damasco. Foi também entregue nas mãos do rei de Israel, que lhe infligiu grande derrota.

verses.original: וַיַּהֲרֹג֩ פֶּ֨קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֜הוּ בִּֽיהוּדָ֗ה מֵאָ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד הַכֹּ֣ל בְּנֵי־ חָ֑יִל בְּעָזְבָ֕ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·hă·rōḡ pe·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū bî·hū·ḏāh mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ bə·yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ hak·kōl bə·nê- ḥā·yil bə·‘ā·zə·ḇām ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: For in one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed 120,000 . . . . . . valiant men in Judah This happened because they had forsaken the LORD the God of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Pois Peca, filho de Remalias, matou em Judá, num só dia, cento e vinte mil homens, todos homens valentes, porque tinham abandonado a Jeová, Deus de seus pais.

verses.original: וַֽיַּהֲרֹ֞ג זִכְרִ֣י׀ גִּבּ֣וֹר אֶפְרַ֗יִם אֶת־ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאֶת־ עַזְרִיקָ֖ם נְגִ֣יד הַבָּ֑יִת וְאֶת־ אֶלְקָנָ֖ה מִשְׁנֵ֥ה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·hă·rōḡ ziḵ·rî gib·bō·wr ’ep̄·ra·yim ’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śê·yā·hū ben- ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- ‘az·rî·qām nə·ḡîḏ hab·bā·yiṯ wə·’eṯ- ’el·qā·nāh miš·nêh ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Zichri a mighty man of Ephraim killed Maaseiah the son of the king Azrikam the governor of the palace and Elkanah the second to the king
verses.literalPt: Zicri, homem poderoso de Efraim, matou a Maaseias, filho do rei, a Azricão, mordomo-mor, e a Elcana, o segundo depois do rei.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ֩ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל מֵֽאֲחֵיהֶ֜ם מָאתַ֣יִם אֶ֗לֶף נָשִׁים֙ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֔וֹת וְגַם־ שָׁלָ֥ל רָ֖ב בָּזְז֣וּ מֵהֶ֑ם וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֶת־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ל לְשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·bū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’ă·ḥê·hem mā·ṯa·yim ’e·lep̄ nā·šîm bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ wə·ḡam- šā·lāl rāḇ bā·zə·zū mê·hem way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- haš·šā·lāl lə·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: Then the Israelites . . . took 200,000 . . . captives from their kinsmen women sons and daughters They also carried off a great deal of plunder and brought it to Samaria
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel levaram cativos de seus irmãos duzentos mil, mulheres, filhos e filhas, e deles tiraram muitos despojos, e os levaram para Samaria.

verses.original: וְ֠שָׁם הָיָ֨ה נָבִ֥יא לַֽיהוָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד שְׁמוֹ֒ וַיֵּצֵ֗א לִפְנֵ֤י הַצָּבָא֙ הַבָּ֣א לְשֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם הִ֠נֵּה בַּחֲמַ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם עַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה נְתָנָ֣ם בְּיֶדְכֶ֑ם וַתַּֽהַרְגוּ־ בָ֣ם בְזַ֔עַף עַ֥ד לַשָּׁמַ֖יִם הִגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šām hā·yāh nā·ḇî Yah·weh ‘ō·ḏêḏ šə·mōw way·yê·ṣê lip̄·nê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā hab·bā lə·šō·mə·rō·wn way·yō·mer lā·hem hin·nêh ba·ḥă·maṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh nə·ṯā·nām bə·yeḏ·ḵem wat·ta·har·ḡū- ḇām ḇə·za·‘ap̄ ‘aḏ laš·šā·ma·yim hig·gî·a‘
verses.literal: But a prophet of the LORD named Oded was there and he went out to meet the army that returned to Samaria Look he said to them because of His wrath against Judah the LORD the God of your fathers has delivered them into your hand But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches up to heaven
verses.literalPt: Mas estava ali um profeta de Jeová, cujo nome era Obede, o qual, saindo ao encontro do exército que vinha para Samaria, lhes disse: Porque Jeová, Deus de vossos pais, estava irado contra Judá, por isso vo-los entregou às mãos, e vós os matastes com uma raiva que chegou até o céu.

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּה בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֤ה וִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים לִכְבֹּ֛שׁ לַעֲבָדִ֥ים וְלִשְׁפָח֖וֹת לָכֶ֑ם הֲלֹ֤א רַק־ אַתֶּם֙ עִמָּכֶ֣ם אֲשָׁמ֔וֹת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh bə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm liḵ·bōš la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·liš·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ lā·ḵem hă·lō raq- ’at·tem ‘im·mā·ḵem ’ă·šā·mō·wṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: And now you intend to reduce to slavery the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem But are you . . . not also guilty before the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Agora, vós pensais em sujeitar os filhos de Judá e de Jerusalém para vos serem escravos e escravas; porém não há entre vós, sim, entre vós, transgressores contra Jeová, vosso Deus?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה שְׁמָע֔וּנִי וְהָשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ הַשִּׁבְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁבִיתֶ֖ם מֵאֲחֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֛י חֲר֥וֹן אַף־ יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·mā·‘ū·nî wə·hā·šî·ḇū haš·šiḇ·yāh ’ă·šer šə·ḇî·ṯem mê·’ă·ḥê·ḵem kî ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Now therefore listen to me and return the captives you took from your kinsmen for the fierce anger . . . of the LORD is upon you
verses.literalPt: Agora, ouvi-me e tornai a enviar os cativos que fizestes entre vossos irmãos, porque o ardor da ira de Jeová está sobre vós.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֨מוּ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵרָאשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ אֶפְרַ֗יִם עֲזַרְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־ יְהֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּרֶכְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ מְשִׁלֵּמ֔וֹת וִֽיחִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ שַׁלֻּ֔ם וַעֲמָשָׂ֖א בֶּן־ חַדְלָ֑י עַל־ הַבָּאִ֖ים מִן־ הַצָּבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū ’ă·nā·šîm mê·rā·šê ḇə·nê- ’ep̄·ra·yim ‘ă·zar·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·ḥā·nān be·reḵ·yā·hū ḇen- mə·šil·lê·mō·wṯ wî·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ben- šal·lum wa·‘ă·mā·śā ben- ḥaḏ·lāy ‘al- hab·bā·’îm min- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: Then some of the leaders of the Ephraimites . . . Azariah son of Jehohanan Berechiah son of Meshillemoth Jehizkiah son of Shallum and Amasa son of Hadlai stood in opposition to those arriving from the war
verses.literalPt: Então, alguns dos cabeças dos filhos de Efraim, a saber, Azarias, filho de Joanã, Berequias, filho de Mesilemote, Jeizquias, filho de Salum, e Amasa, filho de Hadlai, se levantaram contra os que voltavam da guerra

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם לֹא־ תָבִ֤יאוּ אֶת־ הַשִּׁבְיָה֙ הֵ֔נָּה כִּי֩ לְאַשְׁמַ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים לְהֹסִ֥יף עַל־ חַטֹּאתֵ֖ינוּ וְעַל־ אַשְׁמָתֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־ רַבָּ֤ה אַשְׁמָה֙ לָ֔נוּ וַחֲר֥וֹן אָ֖ף עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lā·hem lō- ṯā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- haš·šiḇ·yāh hên·nāh kî lə·’aš·maṯ Yah·weh ‘ā·lê·nū ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm lə·hō·sîp̄ ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯê·nū wə·‘al- ’aš·mā·ṯê·nū kî- rab·bāh ’aš·māh lā·nū wa·ḥă·rō·wn ’āp̄ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: You must not bring the captives here they said for you are proposing to bring guilt upon us from the LORD and to add to our sins and our guilt For our guilt is great and fierce anger . . . is upon Israel
verses.literalPt: e lhes disseram: Não fareis entrar aqui os cativos, porque a vossa intenção é fazer-nos culpados diante de Jeová, aumentando os nossos pecados e a nossa culpa. A nossa culpa já é grande, e o ardor da ira de Jeová está sobre nós.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲזֹ֣ב הֶֽחָל֗וּץ אֶת־ הַשִּׁבְיָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַבִּזָּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַשָּׂרִ֖ים וְכָל־ הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ he·ḥā·lūṣ ’eṯ- haš·šiḇ·yāh wə·’eṯ- hab·biz·zāh lip̄·nê haś·śā·rîm wə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the leaders and all the assembly
verses.literalPt: Os homens armados deixaram os cativos e os despojos diante dos príncipes e de toda a congregação.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֩ אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְּב֨וּ בְשֵׁמ֜וֹת וַיַּחֲזִ֣יקוּ בַשִּׁבְיָ֗ה וְכָֽל־ מַעֲרֻמֵּיהֶם֮ הִלְבִּ֣ישׁוּ מִן־ הַשָּׁלָל֒ וַיַּלְבִּשׁ֣וּם וַ֠יַּנְעִלוּם וַיַּאֲכִל֨וּם וַיַּשְׁק֜וּם וַיְסֻכ֗וּם וַיְנַהֲל֤וּם בַּחֲמֹרִים֙ לְכָל־ כּוֹשֵׁ֔ל וַיְבִיא֛וּם יְרֵח֥וֹ עִיר־ הַתְּמָרִ֖ים אֵ֣צֶל אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּשׁ֖וּבוּ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- niq·qə·ḇū ḇə·šê·mō·wṯ way·ya·ḥă·zî·qū ḇaš·šiḇ·yāh wə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·rum·mê·hem hil·bî·šū min- haš·šā·lāl way·yal·bi·šūm way·yan·‘i·lūm way·ya·’ă·ḵi·lūm way·yaš·qūm way·su·ḵūm way·na·hă·lūm ba·ḥă·mō·rîm lə·ḵāl kō·wō·šêl way·ḇî·’ūm yə·rê·ḥōw ‘îr- hat·tə·mā·rîm ’ê·ṣel ’ă·ḥê·hem way·yā·šū·ḇū šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: Then the men who were designated by name arose took charge of the captives and provided from the plunder clothing for the naked They clothed them gave them sandals and food and drink anointed their wounds and put all the feeble on donkeys So they brought them to Jericho the City of Palms to their brothers Then they returned to Samaria
verses.literalPt: Os homens acima mencionados levantaram-se, e tomaram os cativos, e do despojo vestiram a todos os que estavam nus, e proveram-nos de vestidos e de calçados, e deram-lhes de comer e de beber, e ungiram-nos, e fizeram montar em jumentos a todos que estavam fracos, e levaram-nos a Jericó, Cidade das Palmeiras, a seus irmãos. Depois, voltaram para Samaria.

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא שָׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ אָחָ֛ז עַל־ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר לַעְזֹ֥ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·‘êṯ ha·hî šā·laḥ ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz ‘al- mal·ḵê ’aš·šūr la‘·zōr lōw
verses.literal: At that time King Ahaz sent for help from the king of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Nesse tempo, o rei Acaz mandou pedir socorro aos reis da Assíria,

verses.original: וְע֥וֹד אֲדוֹמִ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַיַּכּ֥וּ בִיהוּדָ֖ה וַיִּשְׁבּוּ־ שֶֽׁבִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·wḏ ’ă·ḏō·w·mîm bā·’ū way·yak·kū ḇî·hū·ḏāh way·yiš·bū- še·ḇî
verses.literal: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away captives
verses.literalPt: pois, de novo, os edomitas tinham vindo, ferido a Judá e levado cativos.

verses.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים פָּשְׁט֗וּ בְּעָרֵ֨י הַשְּׁפֵלָ֣ה וְהַנֶּגֶב֮ לִֽיהוּדָה֒ וַֽ֠יִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־ בֵּֽית־ שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ וְאֶת־ אַיָּל֜וֹן וְאֶת־ הַגְּדֵר֗וֹת וְאֶת־ שׂוֹכ֤וֹ וּבְנוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ וְאֶת־ תִּמְנָ֣ה וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ גִּמְז֖וֹ וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm pā·šə·ṭū bə·‘ā·rê haš·šə·p̄ê·lāh wə·han·ne·ḡeḇ lî·hū·ḏāh way·yil·kə·ḏū ’eṯ- bêṯ- še·meš wə·’eṯ- ’ay·yā·lō·wn wə·’eṯ- hag·gə·ḏê·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- śō·w·ḵōw ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·’eṯ- tim·nāh ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·’eṯ- gim·zōw wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯe·hā way·yê·šə·ḇū šām
verses.literal: The Philistines had also raided the cities of the foothills and the Negev of Judah capturing and occupying . . . Beth-shemesh Aijalon and Gederoth as well as Soco - Timnah and Gimzo with their villages
verses.literalPt: Também os filisteus tinham invadido as cidades da Sefelá e do Neguebe de Judá, e tinham tomado a Bete-Semes, a Aijalom, a Gederote, e a Socó com suas aldeias, a Timna com suas aldeias e a Ginzo com suas aldeias, e ali habitaram.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִכְנִ֤יעַ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה בַּעֲב֖וּר אָחָ֣ז מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י הִפְרִ֙יעַ֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וּמָע֥וֹל מַ֖עַל בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hiḵ·nî·a‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh ba·‘ă·ḇūr ’ā·ḥāz me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl kî hip̄·rî·a‘ bî·hū·ḏāh ū·mā·‘ō·wl ma·‘al Yah·weh
verses.literal: For the LORD humbled Judah because Ahaz king of Israel . . . had thrown off restraint in Judah and had been most unfaithful . . . to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Jeová humilhou a Judá por causa de Acaz, rei de Israel, porque este se houve desregradamente em Judá e cometeu muitíssimas transgressões contra Jeová.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א עָלָ֔יו תִּלְּגַ֥ת פִּלְנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיָּ֥צַר ל֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א חֲזָקֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ‘ā·lāw til·lə·ḡaṯ pil·nə·’e·ser me·leḵ ’aš·šūr way·yā·ṣar lōw wə·lō ḥă·zā·qōw
verses.literal: Then Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came to Ahaz but afflicted him rather than strengthening him
verses.literalPt: Tiglate-Pileser, rei da Assíria, veio a ele, mas o afligiu e não o corroborou.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חָלַ֤ק אָחָז֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִ֑ים וַיִּתֵּן֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְלֹ֥א לְעֶזְרָ֖ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥā·laq ’ā·ḥāz ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- bêṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·haś·śā·rîm way·yit·tên lə·me·leḵ ’aš·šūr wə·lō lə·‘ez·rāh lōw
verses.literal: Although Ahaz had taken a portion from the house of the LORD from the royal palace and from the princes and had presented it to the king of Assyria it did not help him
verses.literalPt: Porque Acaz tomou despojos da Casa de Jeová e da casa do rei e dos príncipes e os deu ao rei da Assíria; porém isso não lhe serviu de nada.

verses.original: וּבְעֵת֙ הָצֵ֣ר ל֔וֹ וַיּ֖וֹסֶף לִמְע֣וֹל בַּיהוָ֑ה ה֖וּא הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אָחָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·‘êṯ hā·ṣêr lōw way·yō·w·sep̄ lim·‘ō·wl Yah·weh hū ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz
verses.literal: In the time of his distress King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the LORD
verses.literalPt: No tempo da sua angústia, cometeu ainda maiores transgressões contra Jeová, este mesmo rei Acaz.

verses.original: וַיִּזְבַּ֗ח לֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י דַרְמֶשֶׂק֮ הַמַּכִּ֣ים בּוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כִּ֠י אֱלֹהֵ֤י מַלְכֵֽי־ אֲרָם֙ הֵ֚ם מַעְזְרִ֣ים אוֹתָ֔ם לָהֶ֥ם אֲזַבֵּ֖חַ וְיַעְזְר֑וּנִי וְהֵ֛ם הָֽיוּ־ ל֥וֹ לְהַכְשִׁיל֖וֹ וּלְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·baḥ lê·lō·hê ḏar·me·śeq ham·mak·kîm bōw way·yō·mer kî ’ĕ·lō·hê mal·ḵê- ’ă·rām hêm ma‘·zə·rîm ’ō·w·ṯām lā·hem ’ă·zab·bê·aḥ wə·ya‘·zə·rū·nî wə·hêm hā·yū- lōw lə·haḵ·šî·lōw ū·lə·ḵāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: He sacrificed to the gods of Damascus who had defeated him and he said Because the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them I will sacrifice to them that they may help me But these gods were the downfall of Ahaz and of all Israel
verses.literalPt: Pois ofereceu sacrifícios aos deuses de Damasco, que o feriram, e disse: Porque os deuses dos reis da Síria os ajudam, portanto lhes oferecerei sacrifícios, para que me ajudem a mim. Porém eles foram a ruína dele e de todo o Israel.

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֨ף אָחָ֜ז אֶת־ כְּלֵ֣י בֵית־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים וַיְקַצֵּץ֙ אֶת־ כְּלֵ֣י בֵית־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיִּסְגֹּ֖ר אֶת־ דַּלְת֣וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּ֨עַשׂ ל֧וֹ מִזְבְּח֛וֹת בְּכָל־ פִּנָּ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ ’ā·ḥāz ’eṯ- kə·lê ḇêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·qaṣ·ṣêṣ ’eṯ- kə·lê ḇêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yis·gōr ’eṯ- dal·ṯō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh way·ya·‘aś lōw miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ bə·ḵāl pin·nāh bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Then Ahaz gathered up the articles of the house of God cut them . . . . . . into pieces shut the doors of the house of the LORD and set up altars of his own on every street corner in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Acaz ajuntou os vasos da Casa de Deus, fê-los em pedaços e fechou as portas da Casa de Jeová; e fez para si altares em todos os cantos de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּבְכָל־ עִ֨יר וָעִ֤יר לִֽיהוּדָה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה בָמ֔וֹת לְקַטֵּ֖ר לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַיַּכְעֵ֕ס אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḵāl ‘îr wā·‘îr lî·hū·ḏāh ‘ā·śāh ḇā·mō·wṯ lə·qaṭ·ṭêr lê·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm way·yaḵ·‘ês ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: In every city . . . of Judah he built high places to offer incense to other gods and so he provoked the LORD the God of his fathers
verses.literalPt: Em cada uma das cidades de Judá, fez altos para queimar incenso a outros deuses e provocou a ira de Jeová, Deus de seus pais.

verses.original: וְיֶ֤תֶר דְּבָרָיו֙ וְכָל־ דְּרָכָ֔יו הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־ סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer də·ḇā·rāw wə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw hā·ri·šō·nîm wə·hā·’a·ḥă·rō·w·nîm hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er mal·ḵê- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaz and all his ways from beginning to end they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o resto dos seus atos e todos os seus caminhos, tanto os primeiros como os últimos, estão escritos no Livro dos Reis de Judá e de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב אָחָ֜ז עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֤הוּ בָעִיר֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּ֚י לֹ֣א הֱבִיאֻ֔הוּ לְקִבְרֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְחִזְקִיָּ֥הֽוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ’ā·ḥāz ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·ru·hū ḇā·‘îr bî·rū·šā·lim kî lō hĕ·ḇî·’u·hū lə·qiḇ·rê mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl way·yim·lōḵ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of Jerusalem but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel And his son Hezekiah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Adormeceu Acaz com seus pais, e sepultaram-no na cidade, em Jerusalém, pois não o puseram no sepulcro dos reis de Israel. Em lugar dele, reinou seu filho Ezequias.
